name: Bow
overview: The Bible presents the bow both as a physical weapon used in war and hunting, and as a significant divine symbol. In Genesis 9, God establishes His covenant with Noah and all living creatures, setting His bow in the clouds as a perpetual token that He will never again destroy the earth by flood. This dual usage highlights the bow’s practical role in human conflict and survival, as well as its profound representation of God's faithfulness and mercy toward creation.
